about: Boss-fight sustain caps only to stop on-hit heals and life steal from fully cancelling incoming damage, so endgame content (rifts, Ashen uniques) can still threaten. On-hit heals (Warm Return and similar) and life steal share a light budget of 4% of max life per second, and life steal is also halved vs a living boss. Flasks and life regeneration are not included. There is no Mael-difficulty target: a full Mythical kit is allowed to be very strong.
